title: Unify Dataset Agent runtime flow and audit_failed helper
verify: The refactored runtime.py has one module-private shared flow core (prepare/scope/candidate/post-I/O guard/rollback/audit) and the two public service classes are thin adapters; per-service divergence (governance writes nothing; curator persists advisory and atomically applies the selected gate; curator _audit ends the DB transaction on append failure) is preserved.

All three audit_failed construction sites use the single module-level _audit_failed_outcome(command, *, model_ref, provider_call_status, curator_gate_result) helper and follow the documented curator_gate_result convention recorded spec-first in dataset-agents-runtime.md.
DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1 semantics, the outcome matrix, and the event payload schema are unchanged; the full governance/curator runtime suites and the full deterministic suite stay green.

purpose: Remove the near-duplicated governance/curator runtime skeleton and the triplicated divergent audit_failed construction so the two Dataset Agent services share one module-private flow core and one _audit_failed_outcome helper with a documented curator_gate_result convention, preserving every public outcome.
success_outcome: backend/app/dataset_governance/runtime.py exposes one module-private shared flow core parameterized by prepared-run type, decision type, and gate-result mapping, with DatasetGovernanceRuntimeService and TrainingDataCuratorRuntimeService as thin adapters; all three audit_failed construction sites use one module-level _audit_failed_outcome(command, *, model_ref, provider_call_status, curator_gate_result) helper under a documented curator_gate_result convention recorded in .memory-bank/contracts/dataset-agents-runtime.md; DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1 semantics, the outcome matrix, the event payload, and public behavior are unchanged and the full governance/curator runtime suites stay green.
anti_goals: No change to DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1 fields/validation, the _validate_outcome_matrix rules, or the dataset_agent_runtime_decided event payload schema.
No change to public service class signatures, public behavior, provider/request/result contracts, service.py/repository.py/contracts.py, or runtime_contracts.py semantics.

evidence_required: W5-1 RED: before this task the two runtime services duplicate the prepare/scope/candidate/guard/audit skeleton by copy (governance runtime.py:200-358 vs curator runtime.py:596-819) with observable drift (curator _audit calls _end_database_transaction() on append failure, governance does not); GREEN: one module-private shared flow core serves both services with the two public classes as thin adapters and the drifted per-service behavior is preserved; decisive comparison: identical public outcome matrix on the full runtime suites before vs after; artifact: focused runtime transcripts under .tasks/TASK-060-T2-FT-014-W6/.

W5-2 RED: three inline near-identical audit_failed constructions record different curator_gate_result values (governance and curator gate-failure branch hard-code not_applicable, curator _audit preserves the attempted value at runtime.py:803); GREEN: all three sites call the single _audit_failed_outcome helper under the documented convention recorded spec-first in dataset-agents-runtime.md's audit_failed matrix row; decisive comparison: one construction site and per-site gate-result values consistent with the convention; artifact: static scan plus runtime tests.

Matrix-parity GREEN: after the refactor the exact governance and curator outcome/audit matrices, advisory-only persistence, atomic selected curator_auto gate, and rollback behavior are unchanged; decisive comparison: curator_agent_command + governance_curator_runtime + dataset_governance_regression gates green before and after; artifact: gate transcripts.
constraints: Spec-first: record the documented curator_gate_result convention on audit_failed in .memory-bank/contracts/dataset-agents-runtime.md (the audit_failed matrix row) before the code change; no other spec change.

Documented convention: on audit_failed, curator_gate_result records the attempted gate-result value the failing run would have recorded had the audit append succeeded — not_applicable when no gate is attempted, not_requested for silent/deferred/rejected runs, confirmed/policy_blocked for the selected-gate application surface — so an observer can tell whether a gate was attempted.

The shared flow core is parameterized by prepared-run type, decision type, and gate-result mapping and must preserve the per-service divergence current tests pin (governance writes nothing; curator persists the advisory allowlist and atomically applies the selected gate; curator _audit ends the DB transaction on append failure).
Keep both public service class public signatures and public behavior; _audit_failed_outcome(command, *, model_ref, provider_call_status, curator_gate_result) is module-private.
No change to DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1 validation, _validate_outcome_matrix, or the event payload schema.
invariants: Every accepted attempt still appends exactly one dataset_agent_runtime_decided event; audit_failed returns no result and no event ref and rolls back pending advisory/lifecycle mutations.
Governance and curator public outcomes are identical to the pre-refactor matrix for every accepted branch.
All three audit_failed construction sites follow the documented curator_gate_result convention.
verification_targets: Static scan: exactly one module-level _audit_failed_outcome helper used by all three audit_failed sites; one shared flow core; no public signature change.

forbidden_scope: DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1, _validate_outcome_matrix, runtime_contracts.py, service.py, repository.py, contracts.py, provider/request/result contracts
Event payload schema or public service class signatures/public behavior
Feature lifecycle/queue state and any spec change beyond the audit_failed matrix row
stop_conditions: The refactor requires a change to DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1 validation, the outcome matrix, or the event payload schema.

The shared flow core cannot preserve the two services' distinct behaviors (governance writes nothing; curator persists advisory and atomically applies the selected gate; curator _audit ends the DB transaction on append failure) without a public behavior change.
A documented curator_gate_result convention cannot satisfy both the matrix constraints and the existing runtime tests.
The dataset_governance or full deterministic regression cannot be green.
